---
title: "Figure 2 - Load and prepare data"
output: html_document
---

Run this notebook first. It prepares the cord-blood and infant data used for
the variant heatmap and Omicron comparison.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
helper_dir <- if (dir.exists("../helpful_functions")) {
  "../helpful_functions"
} else {
  "helpful_functions"
}
source(file.path(helper_dir, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "analysis_functions.R"))

load_rdata("infant_data.RData", "infant_data")
load_rdata("infant_metadata.RData", "infant_meta")
load_rdata("cord_data.RData", "CB_data_v2")
load_rdata("cord_metadata.RData", "CB_meta_v2")
load_rdata("negative_control_thresholds.RData", "neg_control_threshold")
```

## Separate infant visits

```{r split-timepoints}
m2 <- subset_timepoint(infant_data, infant_meta, "M2")
m6 <- subset_timepoint(infant_data, infant_meta, "M6")

infant_data_M2 <- m2$data
infant_meta_M2 <- m2$metadata
infant_data_M6 <- m6$data
infant_meta_M6 <- m6$metadata
```

## Apply detection thresholds

```{r detection-status}
infant_data_persist <- apply_detection_thresholds(
  infant_data,
  neg_control_threshold
)
CB_data_persist <- apply_detection_thresholds(
  CB_data_v2,
  neg_control_threshold
)

infant_persist_M2 <- infant_data_persist[infant_meta$Timepoint == "M2", ]
infant_persist_M6 <- infant_data_persist[infant_meta$Timepoint == "M6", ]
```
